summary:
Highly accomplished computer science professor with over 20 years of experience teaching at the
university level, seeking a full time position which is research and industry oriented to enable improve
technological standards in overall learning community. Demonstrated excellence in teaching and
research, and a strong commitment to student success.

education.raw_text: PhD Gujarat University, Department of Computer Science April 2020 Title: “An Innovative Framework for Remote Database Experimentation” MCA IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University), Computer Science May 2007

experience.raw_text:  Department of Computer Science, Gujarat University, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
o Provided comprehensive academic support to the head of the Department of Computer Science.

o Taught MCA(Masters of Computer Application students) – masters course averaging 40 students per semester covering following topics: Database Management Systems, Java Programming and Full stack Development  Developed GU_DB, a Database system Prototype, integrated with Virtual laboratory as a front end. Published a paper in the International Journal of Advanced Computer Research.  Integrated GU_DB with Automated Assessment of SQL Queries and published the work in FICTA-2021, NIT Mizoram.  Conducted research on Image processing for training image pixels, resulting in the publication of the work on ImageGPT with Super resolution in February 2022.  Extensive work on Query Optimization in various contexts.  Created an Innovative Framework for Remote Database Experimentation, integrating it with Learning Management Systems hosted at IIT-B portal.

skills:  Proficient in Database Management Systems (DBMS), Java Programming, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and

ther relevant programming languages.  Strong expertise in Query Optimization, Image Processing, and Virtual Labs.  Excellent research and publication track record, with experience presenting papers at conferences.  Effective communication and interpersonal skills, demonstrated through mentoring, counseling, and academic support roles.  Proven ability to design syllabi and develop pedagogical strategies for STEM courses.  Project management skills, including proposal writing, resource coordination, and event organization.  Knowledge of industry practices and trends in the IT sector.
